name: Halloween Night Glitch
original_name: ハロウィンナイト・グリッチ
source:
This is Ghosttown, where the undead live. One day, Pim's younger brother Sawin wants to celebrate Halloween, but Pim herself doesn't seem up to it...?

[Translated from the [url=http://endingerror.web.fc2.com/hnglitch/index.html]official website[/url]]
